Hollis now has the Thornbury Cloth Co. rate. I sent it to them in a direct message.

I could not see Hollis's original request in this thread, so I went by your approval and the signed renewal order form (executed 2/24/26, effective 3/1/26 to 2/28/27). That rate is **$1,700 per seat per year** for Pemberline Dock. I did not include the unsigned February draft's figures.

If you meant a different figure, such as a discount, tell me and I'll correct it with Hollis.
